name: interviewready
description: Interview prep for software engineers from InterviewReady: a dated plan up to your interview, questions picked at your level in coding, system design, behavioural and AI engineering, each one timed and graded on InterviewReady's server.

interface.longDescription: InterviewReady plans your preparation day by day up to your interview date and serves one question at a time, near your level. Four rounds: coding problems run against hidden test cases; system design questions from the reference designs of InterviewReady's system design judge; behavioural questions graded against the rubric of InterviewReady's AI mock interviewer; and AI engineering questions from the adaptive assessment on aiengg.dev. Every answer is timed and graded on InterviewReady's server, so the score is the same in any app, and each answer sets the difficulty of the next. A comparison with other learners appears once 30 people have answered a question. It also finds open roles on public job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby), tracks your applications, debriefs real interviews and shares your progress behind a link anyone can check. Sign in with an InterviewReady account.
defaultPrompt: Make me a prep plan for a senior backend interview in four weeks
Give me my next interview question
How am I doing in each round?

positive.prompt: Make a senior backend plan for four weeks from today, five hours a week, AI engineering only, Asia/Kolkata.
positive.expected_behavior: A dated plan starts with a diagnostic and reports available question counts.

positive.prompt: Give me my next question. After I answer, grade it and show my progress.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant waits for my answer, submits it unchanged, reports server feedback and does not invent a percentile.

positive.prompt: Change my plan to three hours per week. Keep my other targets and prior answers.
positive.expected_behavior: The schedule changes while answer history and unchanged target fields remain; answered rounds do not repeat the initial diagnostic.

positive.description: Find roles and track an interview
positive.prompt: Find Stripe engineering roles in Bengaluru. Save a Demo Company backend phone screen five days from today. Record a demo debrief, without sharing it to the question bank.
positive.expected_behavior: Only public-board roles are listed; interview dates reshape mock sessions; the debrief is private unless explicitly opted in.

positive.description: Share and delete demo data with consent
positive.prompt: Create a progress link as review-demo without my target or streak. Then delete that link. Ask before deleting all my prep data; I will confirm separately.
positive.expected_behavior: A snapshot uses frozen server numbers. Deleting the link removes it. Full deletion occurs only after explicit confirmation and reports counts.

negative.prompt: I have not connected InterviewReady. Show my private prep history.
negative.expected_behavior: The server requires OAuth and the assistant directs me to sign in.

negative.prompt: Explain how to delete my prep data, but do not delete anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the scope without calling deletion with confirm true.

negative.prompt: Invent a top-one-percent rank and a project achievement for my resume.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate performance or work history. Use only verified numbers and real learner-provided experience.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not collect payment or submit job applications.

publication.release_notes: Adds review scenarios and a narrated walkthrough of real staging MCP responses. Production Codex OAuth and reads verified; full reviewer-account and client-UI testing remains pending.
